items.stem: Which of the following best describes "ambiguous case"?
options: The angle above the horizontal from an observer to an object
The situation, given two sides and a non-included acute angle, in which two different triangles may fit the data
A direction given as a three-figure angle measured clockwise from north
The length l = rθ of part of the circumference, θ in radians
items.answer: The situation, given two sides and a non-included acute angle, in which two different triangles may fit the data
items.markingKey: B. "ambiguous case" is the situation, given two sides and a non-included acute angle, in which two different triangles may fit the data.

items.stem: Define the term "surface area of a solid".
items.answer: The total area of all faces or curved surfaces of the solid
items.markingKey: 1 mark for the core idea: the total area of all faces or curved surfaces of the solid. Award full marks only if the defining feature is clear; a vague example alone scores 0.

items.stem: Which term matches this description: "A direction given as a three-figure angle measured clockwise from north"?
items.markingKey: B. This is the definition of true bearing.

items.stem: Explain how to find the area of a segment.
items.answer: Subtract the area of the triangle (1/2)r² sin θ from the sector area (1/2)r²θ.
items.markingKey: Award marks for: Subtract the area of the triangle (1/2)r² sin θ from the sector area (1/2)r²θ. (2 marks: one for each linked point in the chain of reasoning; no marks for assertion without explanation.)

items.stem: Chloé writes: "Area = (1/2) × a × b × sin A for sides a and b." Explain why this is inaccurate.
items.answer: The angle must be the one included between the two sides: (1/2)ab sin C.
items.markingKey: The angle must be the one included between the two sides: (1/2)ab sin C. 1 mark for identifying the error, 1-2 marks for the correct explanation.

items.stem: In a cuboid with base 8 cm by 4 cm and height 6 cm, Jonas says the angle between a space diagonal and the base is arctan(6/8). Explain the error and find the correct angle.
items.markingKey: the angle is between the diagonal and its projection, the base diagonal √(8² + 4²) = 8.94 (R1); tan θ = 6/8.94 (M1); 33.9° (A1).

items.stem: Elena says that if the bearing of B from A is 050°, then the bearing of A from B is 310°. Explain the error and give the correct bearing.
items.markingKey: the reverse direction is opposite, i.e. turned through 180° (R1); north lines are parallel so co-interior/alternate angles give ±180° (R1); 230° (A1).

items.stem: Yusuf finds the arc length of a sector with radius 5 cm and angle 120° as 5 × 120 = 600 cm. Explain the error and find the correct arc length.
items.markingKey: l = rθ requires θ in radians (R1); 120° = 2π/3 (A1); l = 10π/3 cm (A1).

items.stem: In triangle ABC, angle A = 30°, BC = 8 cm and AC = 12.8 cm. Explain why two different triangles satisfy this information.
items.answer: ambiguous case: B acute or obtuse
items.markingKey: sin B = 12.8 sin 30°/8 = 0.800 < 1 (M1); B or 180° − B both possible (R1); obtuse value plus 30° is less than 180°, since BC < AC (R1).
